verdict.rationale: Turso ships an official MCP server that lets any MCP-capable AI agent manage the Turso Cloud account (create/manage databases, orgs, groups) and run SQL 'on your behalf,' which enables natural-language operation via an AI agent intermediary rather than a native NL interface in the product itself. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of natural-language MCP usage, and evidence of a first-party conversational/NL interface outside MCP.
